test_dropout_sum_close: test the Dropout module preserves the sum of inputs when switching between training and inference modes
test_dropout_rate: test the Dropout module drops the correct fraction of elements based on the specified dropout rate
test_dropout_is_actually_random: test the Dropout module produces different outputs across multiple forward passes during training
test_tf_function_with_booleans: test the Dropout module works correctly when wrapped in tf.function with boolean autograph settings
test_tf_function_with_variables: test the Dropout module works correctly when wrapped in tf.function with tf.Variable is_training argument
